provenance.method: Triangle-centroid assignment to nearest sampled approved URDF visual surface
limitations: Automatic rigid cuts need review at housings, wires and occlusions.
No inferred inner surfaces, cable simulation, collision validation or gripper finger articulation.
LACT scan surfaces follow their assigned links; precise telescoping geometry remains a separate refinement.
Rigid scan assignments are provisional; cables, missing surfaces, payloads and the environment are not certified.
